mapper.select: SELECT * FROM learnings INNER JOIN categories ON categories.id = learnings.category_id WHERE learnings.delete_flg = 0 AND learnings.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY learnings.id ASC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM tags WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT learning_tags.* FROM learning_tags INNER JOIN learnings ON learnings.id = learning_tags.learning_id WHERE learnings.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY learning_tags.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learnings (title, explanatory_text, understanding_level, reference_url, created_at, category_id, github_path, commit_sha, user_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{explanatory_text}, #{understanding_level}, #{reference_url}, #{created_at}, #{category_id}, #{github_path}, #{commit_sha}, #{user_id});
mapper.update: UPDATE learnings SET title = #{title}, explanatory_text = #{explanatory_text}, understanding_level = #{understanding_level}, reference_url = #{reference_url}, created_at = #{created_at}, category_id = #{category_id}, github_path = #{github_path}, commit_sha = #{commit_sha}, user_id = #{user_id} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_tags INNER JOIN tags ON tags.id = learning_tags.tag_id WHERE learning_tags.tag_id = #{id} AND tags.user_id = #{user_id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_interests (user_id, github_login, created_at) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{github_login}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO inquiries (name, email, message, status, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{message}, 'new', now());
